verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents its own native integrations with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Slack, Figma "and other tools," plus AI-agent connections via its MCP server. That covers connecting the workspace to some third-party tools. Nothing in the evidence shows an app marketplace or a catalog anywhere near thousands of tools; the documented set is a handful of named integrations plus a REST API for building custom ones. missing for 10: an app marketplace/directory, evidence of thousands of available integrations, PM-facing one-click install flow, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can connect my workspace to thousands of third-party tools via an app marketplace

citations.quote: Seamless integrations with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and other tools mean Shortcut updates while you work.
Connect Shortcut to tools like Cursor and Claude Code to get agents coding and synced to GitHub.
